text:
neel: Heads-up  we need a very small go/no-go checklist for GA of routing-optimizer. Keep it to the minimum items execs want to see: SLA, docs, support/responder plan, monitoring, pricing guardrail.

emma: Agreed. Can we do a 5-line checklist that each has an owner and a binary pass/fail? Execs hate prose.

rachel-legal: For SLA we need exact wording: availability target and exclusions. I can approve language if the uptime target is <= 99.95% and we include maintenance window clause.

matt-finops: Pricing guardrail: publish expected unit-cost delta and a 30-day internal backstop. We need a sample invoice from internal test account showing < +30% delta. I'll run that test.

zoe-docs: Docs deliverables: 1-page Quickstart, 1-page Runbook (pager, rollback steps), and a short SLA doc. I can draft Quickstart by Fri.

kai-eng: Engineering acceptance: canary results with metrics below. Canary stop criteria: error_rate > 0.75% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 200ms stable for 10m. Rollback plan in repo at docs/runbooks/routing-optimizer-rollback.md.

ops-bot: Canary window scheduled: 2026-04-08 02:00 UTC -> 2026-04-09 02:00 UTC. Staging smoke passed earlier today.

tom-oncall: I'll take pager for the canary (primary). Add alert: `alerts.routing-optimizer.errors` -> #oncall-pager. Add composite alert for p95 spike.

neel: Monitoring checklist (owners): a) p95 latency (kai), b) error_rate (tom-oncall), c) token_cost_delta (matt-finops), d) cache_hit_ratio (kai). Dashboards must be live and linked in the runbook pre-canary.

emma: For support readiness: 1) triage doc + FAQ (zoe), 2) who-to-call matrix (tom-oncall), 3) commercial playbook for pricing disputes (matt-finops + rachel-legal).

kai-eng: Small snippet for canary config to include in runbook:```yaml
canary:
  duration: 24m
  traffic: 5%
  stop_conditions:
    - error_rate > 0.75%
    - p95_latency > 200ms
  success_criteria:
    - error_rate < 0.5%
    - token_cost_delta < 20%
```

rachel-legal: Note: SLA must include a customer-visible incident contact and the exceptions section. I'll send a 2-sentence template.

matt-finops: I'll post the internal billing snapshot in this thread once the test completes. If delta > +30% we block GA.

zoe-docs: Draft owners assigned in repo: quickstart@zoe, runbook@zoe, sla@rachel-legal. ETA for drafts: Fri EOD.

neel: Final exec checklist (binary pass items):
1) SLA doc approved by legal (rachel-legal) -> PASS/FAIL
2) Runbook + quickstart published (zoe) -> PASS/FAIL
3) Canary metrics meet thresholds (kai + tom-oncall) -> PASS/FAIL
4) Billing test below +30% delta (matt-finops) -> PASS/FAIL
5) Observability dashboards + alerts wired to oncall (kai + tom-oncall) -> PASS/FAIL

emma: If all PASS we greenlight GA rollout. If any FAIL we contingency to postpone and run one more 48h burn.

neel: Ok. Action items: zoe publish drafts, kai wire dashboards and run canary, tom add pager alerts, matt upload billing test, rachel send SLA template. Reconvene Thu 10:30 PT for final go/no-go.

ops-bot: Note: reminder set for 2026-04-07 18:30 PT for go/no-go sync.

neel: Thanks everyone. I'll convert this into a one-page checklist and ping execs after Thu sync. :thumbsup:
